decisions_for_lead: Pigment's reference reads zero beyond its plane (shift_zero, blur, dilate), so render_layer_reference equals the backend only when the plane holds the layer plus its margin; the backend evaluates frames beyond the target and yields the uncut shadow (first stack attempt: 21 px off by 8e-7 .. 3e-4 near the plane edge because the test plane was smaller; the test plane was fixed, not the backend).

Effects together with Blend-If on one layer are refused (effects_with_blend_if): the Blend-If weight depends on the backdrop of the content composite and Photoshop behaviour with effects is UNVERIFIED; pigment admits the combination, so this is a backend-side refusal that happens after shared admission (still before the first sink call).
Effects nested inside the content of an effect layer are refused (effects_nested), same reason: one frame scratch per worker.

Mask on an effect layer multiplies the content alpha (the shape alpha the matte is derived from, pigment module doc); without effects the v1 path multiplies the mask into opacity, so a masked effect layer can differ from the same layer without effects by f32 rounding.
Effect kinds pigment added after wave 1 (d982b5c inner shadow, outer glow, inner glow) are Unsupported here until implemented and tested (kind-by-kind allow list in extension_exactness).
api_changes_needed_in_pigment: Windowed matte API: effect_math::reference_matte / render_layer_reference work on planes of at most 64 x 64 and recompute the margin of every tile, so this backend refuses effect margins above 24 px (effect_margin) and a layer pays (64 / tile side)^2 recompute. A production path needs a matte function over a window with an explicit halo contract (window rect + halo from effect_support_px, no 64 px plane limit, work budget per window) and a streaming dilate/blur; then margins up to MAX_EFFECT_SIZE_PX (1000) become possible.
plausible_not_addressed: EffectPlane / render_layer_reference allocate inside pigment per tile (several 16 KB-class vectors); the scratch charge is an estimate of those allocations (4 bytes per pixel x (effects + 12) + 3 planes of 16 bytes), not a measured bound.

Pixels of an effect region where nothing is drawn are rewritten with the reference's composite_over(a_s = 0) result, which equals the backdrop for opaque backdrops and can differ by an ulp for translucent ones.
Effect compute cost per tile is not charged to a deadline-aware budget; cancel and deadline are observed between chunks only.
